title: Extended noise mass off the diagonal
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\rho\in\mathbb{R}$, and let $x,y\in\Omega$ with $y\ne x$. The extended noise mass at $(x,y)$ is $(1-\rho)/|\Omega|$.
